Name: Screen
Entry_Condition: S = 1 (Single anomaly, topology, or trust signal)

Name: Contain
Entry_Condition: S >= 3 (Three or more corroborating threat signals)

Name: Isolate
Entry_Condition: S >= 3 AND TARP >= 0.75 AND trust <= 20 (Unreached in baseline)

Name: Adaptive
Entry_Condition: S >= 3 AND distinct attack families >= 2 AND trust <= 20
